note: Neon Function triggers for the engine clock (lib/clock/handler.ts). Five-field UTC cron. Minutes 6/21/36/51 land one minute before the learner function's own :07/:22/:37/:52 tick, so the database wakes once per quarter hour for both. Day = 05:00-21:59 UTC Mon-Fri (covers the 02:00-15:25 ET entry window plus the learner's 30-minute settlement in both daylight and standard time); night = hourly. learn and review stay disabled while the learner function runs those jobs itself; enable them, and disable the learner function's triggers, only when the GitHub runner takes over (docs/ENGINE-CLOCK.md).
